description: Source code for FFExecutionContext class handling JavaScript evaluation and object management within Firefox in Playwright's server implementation.

classes.name: FFExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements JavaScript evaluation and object property management for Firefox in Playwright.

methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the context and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle

methods.name: getProperties
